text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No... It's just been hard falling asleep
lately.
choice_data_list_en: Haven't you been able to sleep?
Haven't you been able to sleep?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Geez, no need to freak out! And quit
babying me.
choice_data_list: 大丈夫か！？無理するなよ！？
大丈夫！？無理しないようにね！？
choice_data_list_en: Are you okay!? Don't push yourself!?
Are you okay!? Please don't push yourself!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It happens a lot, anyway. Either I'm not
feeling so
hot or I'm pissed off about
something and can't
sleep.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, why are we even talking about
this? Talk
about kicking me while I'm
already down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin seems deprived of sleep...
I should
go easy on her.
